tasks.final_text: Today I hosted some students from my hometown at Stanford in a short guided tour. My former high school teacher brought these students to hear from me and learn about this highly respected institution. I tried to excite them about Stanford and show them all the cool things that we get to do here. I think it was very fruitful for the students and made me feel great too.

Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.
